name: google-drive
description: workspace-mcp (Google Workspace MCP server, MIT) restricted with --tools drive. uvx fetches on demand; Python 3.10+; uvx-style commands do not need a cmd /c wrapper on Windows.

metadata.install: pip install -U uv or use the Astral installer; uvx workspace-mcp --help
metadata.env_hint: GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET (credentials and token cache default to ~/.config/)
